payload.title: Publish portfolio milestones to the Action Inbox
payload.description:
Living optimization Reports publish durable milestones, but the existing Action Inbox receives no corresponding Updates. Operators looking at the sidebar cannot tell that a long-running analysis started, became ready for review, needs action, or ended.

Feature: Project key portfolio milestones into the existing ChatMessage feed

Scenario: A portfolio run advances through analysis
Given a living Report has durably published a run milestone
When the portfolio coordinator announces that milestone
Then it creates or reuses one idempotent NOTIFICATION ChatMessage for the account and procedure
And the notification links to the same Report
And the Action Inbox shows only the key started, analysis-ready, action-required, work-started, and terminal updates

Scenario: A procedure replays after checkpoint or retry
Given the milestone notification was already created
When the same run and event key are published again
Then no duplicate update is created

Scenario: Sidebar publication fails
Given the authoritative Report milestone is already durable
When notification publication fails
Then the Report remains authoritative
And the failure is retained as run evidence rather than silently converting the Report milestone into failure

Exclusions: No new data model, index, function, storage, or association is introduced.
